text:
vikram: opened PR #6124 to add a Console observability migration checklist + tiny importable panel JSON for cost/latency pairing. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6124. Main items: metric rename notes, tracing-hook examples, and a small Grafana panel JSON.

clare: skimmed it. great layout. small nit: the Go snippet assumes trace.ID has no prefix. we've hit confusion there. please add a normalization example and a one-sentence explanation of why 0x shows up.

hughes: Also add a one-line sed/perl alternative for mac users when remapping exported dashboards. some customers only have mac dev machines.

vikram: noted. adding Go + Node + Python normalization lines. Go: `id := strings.TrimPrefix(trace.ID.String(), "0x")` Node: `const id = (trace.id || '').replace(/^0x/, '')` Python: `trace_id = trace.id.hex(); if trace_id.startswith('0x'): trace_id = trace_id[2:]`

clare: perfect. also please back up exported dashboards before running replacements and include `jq` snippet for nested targets. e.g. `jq '(.panels[]?.targets[]?.expr) |= gsub("console.cost_old"; "console_unit_cost_total")' file.json`

hughes: adding sed and perl examples: `sed -i.bak 's/console.cost_old/console_unit_cost_total/g' exported/*.json` and `perl -pi.bak -e 's/console.cost_old/console_unit_cost_total/g' exported/*.json` (mac users).

doc-bot: Automated check: missing alt text for one uploaded image path `/assets/images/docs/console/cost-panel.png`. Status: fail.

assets-bot: uploaded 1 file to /assets/images/docs/console/cost-panel.png and added alt text: "Before/after cost panel showing unit_cost rollup"

vikram: added a short PromQL example for 15m rollup and a per-token variant: `sum(rate(console_unit_cost_total[15m])) by (service)` and `sum(rate(console_unit_cost_total[15m])) by (service) / sum(rate(token_count_total[15m])) by (service)`

clare: add a smoke test customers can run after migration: `sum(rate(console_unit_cost_total[5m]))` should return non-empty series for services you expect. Also mention to null out `id` fields in panel JSON before import: `jq '(.panels[]?.id) = null' file.json`

hughes: added a short rollback note: keep `.bak` files from sed/perl and a one-line restore: `for f in exported/*.json.bak; do mv "$f" "${f%.bak}"; done` if import fails.

qa-bot: checklist: please include code fence language for PromQL blocks and ensure the panel JSON is valid. Found: promql fence missing. Also recommend a tiny unit test to validate the jq remap in CI.

vikram: fixed fences, validated JSON, and added a tiny GH workflow suggestion to `docs/.github/workflows/check-remap.yml` that runs jq on a sample dashboard to ensure expressions updated. left as an example (opt-in).

clare: LGTM once doc-bot passes. who will merge?

vikram: I'll merge after doc-bot is happy and staging preview looks OK. thanks all :rocket:

doc-bot: Re-running checks... linkcheck OK. Lint: 0 warnings. CI: green.

vikram: Merged and cherry-picked to main. Closing PR. Thanks team :tada:
